images.alt: A grey Mastermind board with rows of coloured code pegs, small black and white scoring pegs, and a tray full of spare pegs.
images.caption: A game of Mastermind, the colour code-breaking board game invented in 1970. Josh Wardle played it a lot as a child, and it helped inspire Wordle
